mapped_intent: Repair current ORODI local runtime and build wiring until a bounded local human test is ready, without running the human test.

exact_mutable_targets.intended_effect: build the current Body War app and auth packages as one workspace image and run dist/server.js
produce the executable gateway image from the current repository toolchain and entrypoint
wire app environment, listener ports, external token, and Prometheus configuration while preserving loopback-only host exposure
validate strengthened build, mount, listener, timeout, preflight, cleanup, and hostile-case invariants without starting services
document the bounded later human-test gate and exact cleanup boundary
document no-effect, build-readiness, preflight, and human-test separation
read the external token, construct a bounded-timeout upstream, and start data, control, and metrics listeners
expose deterministic listener and readiness behavior without widening control authority
support the internal Prometheus metrics listener and readiness assertions
prove listener wiring, token handling, upstream timeout, and readiness behavior without opening live listeners
compile the executable gateway entry and its bounded tests deterministically

provide executable --preflight no-effect validation and, only under later human authorization, run-local token/evidence creation, exact image readiness, exact Compose start/probes, and trap-based exact project cleanup

app_image: Build context consumes exactly projects/body-war/app and projects/auth-user-management as the two-package workspace.
Container command executes the emitted Body War dist/server.js.
Container binds BODY_WAR_HOST=0.0.0.0 and BODY_WAR_PORT=5174 internally.
BODY_WAR_AUTH_BACKEND=memory, BODY_WAR_STRAVA_FAKE=1, BODY_WAR_SECURE_COOKIES=0, and no real provider credentials are used.
Stable and candidate remain exposed only through 127.0.0.1 host mappings.
gateway: Data, control, and metrics listeners bind inside the container on 0.0.0.0 ports 18080, 18081, and 9464 respectively.
Host exposure remains loopback-only and metrics remains internal to the Compose network.
Every upstream call has one deterministic timeout not exceeding one second and preserves terminal accounting.
Control token is read from /run/orodi/control-token and never logged or placed in Compose environment.
mounts: A runner-created external regular token file with host mode 0600 is mounted read-only at /run/orodi/control-token.
No named or durable volume is introduced.
local_runner: --preflight is no-effect: it does not build, pull, create, start, stop, or remove Docker resources and never runs the human test.

The later effectful mode creates only a run-local temporary evidence directory and mode-0600 token, verifies or builds exact image identities, starts one unique exact Compose project, probes exact loopback endpoints, and records bounded evidence.
A trap always invokes docker compose with the same file and project name followed by down --volumes --remove-orphans; no prune, wildcard cleanup, or unrelated resource removal is permitted.
Effectful mode requires a separate explicit human-test authorization token or flag that --preflight cannot satisfy.

permitted: build or obtain the two exact local images
not_permitted: docker compose up or service start

invalidation_rules: Any baseline hash/state drift invalidates this candidate before mutation.
Any required target outside exact_mutable_targets requires a new binding.
Any validation failure stops implementation; the human test remains unready.
Passing readiness validation does not authorize the human test or prove runtime conformance.
claim_ceiling: Candidate local-test-readiness repair binding only. Parent independent join and owner authority are required before implementation. It does not authorize Compose start, the human test, commissioning, runtime admission, conformance, publication, deployment, ontology admission, or external effect.
